conventions.user_meters: Core users are never billed, and requiring MFA never counts a user. Only enterprise SSO and directory integrations count users, once per project, connection or directory, and month, with a cap per connection or directory; threat intelligence counts the users checked against licensed feeds on the projects that turn it on.
conventions.allowance: The same allowance applies on every plan, per account and month; Enterprise contracts may raise it.
conventions.invoice: Pro base fee + metered integrations and consumption beyond included allowances + contracted packages and support; the base fee includes Governance and is not usage credit
conventions.caps: API requests are never billed, so most bills are the base fee. Owners set a monthly budget and get alerts at 50, 80 and 100 percent of it; it notifies and never stops sign-ins or switches security enforcement off.
conventions.self_hosted: Self-hosted installs pay for rights and support per production installation and are never metered.
conventions.packages: Governance and custom security settings are included in Pro. Compliance is quoted per account, with retention duration, retained-event volume, SIEM destinations and any overage prices agreed before activation. No package charges per user or per policy.

free.label: Free
free.over_allowance: Free never bills. A metered feature stops at its allowance until the month ends or an owner chooses Pro: past 1,000 SSO users a month, for example, further users can't sign in through an enterprise connection. Users, passwords, social sign-in, passkeys and MFA never stop, and nothing upgrades by itself.

pro.label: Pro
pro.support: tickets any time, answered the next business day; priority add-on: a 1-hour response for outages

enterprise.label: Enterprise
enterprise.rates: Annual commitment for agreed governance, compliance and operational assurance; metered allowances and overages are specified in the contract.
enterprise.support: response times from 8 hours down to 30 minutes by tier, and a technical account manager

sla.note: 99.95 included; 99.99 is an upgrade requiring a second region

meters.counts: Every active user, shown for information only; never billed and never an upgrade trigger

meters.label: Enterprise SSO users
meters.counts: A user who signs in through an enterprise connection, once a month; billing stops at 750 users ($75) per connection, and every user can still sign in

meters.label: Directory-synced users (SCIM)
meters.counts: A user a directory syncs (SCIM), once a month; billing stops at 750 users ($75) per directory, and every user still syncs

meters.label: Authorization API checks
meters.counts: Each authorization API check; core roles and permissions are free

meters.label: Managed email delivery
meters.counts: Each email managed delivery sends; bringing your own provider has no Zitadel delivery charge

meters.counts: Each SMS managed delivery sends, priced by destination; only to countries the owner allows

meters.label: Service access tokens

meters.counts: A user whose sign-ins are checked against feeds Zitadel licenses, on projects that turn it on: IP reputation, residential proxies included, and leaked credentials. Risk-based challenges and MFA prompts on Zitadel's own signals (device, failed attempts, location, network, bot checks) and on signals the customer brings stay free; rules on them are Governance

Custom contract terms: MSA, indemnification, DORA or BAA
licensed.note: Terms and pricing agreed in the Enterprise contract

licensed.label: Dedicated infrastructure
licensed.note: dedicated database servers and compute, at cost plus margin

self_hosted.unit: production installation: a server and its database serving real end users

includes: tickets, next business day as a target

future.label: Identity analytics hub
future.free_part: Sign-in, MAU and error counts in the console, over the plan's event retention
future.paid_part: Funnels, conversion, sign-in method mix, per-tenant views, anomaly alerts and exports over 90 days
needs: request events in an analytics store rather than Postgres

platform: Login UI in your own app, on your domain
security: Bot verdicts from your edge, such as Vercel or Cloudflare
core.billing: Core resources and Zitadel's secure defaults are free on every plan. Active users and API requests never change your plan or bill; each plan's rate limit still applies.

packages.label: Governance
features: Conditional access on device, network and location
packages.note: No per-user, per-policy or policy-evaluation charge. Requiring MFA for everyone stays free.

packages.label: Custom security settings
features: Custom captcha settings and your own captcha provider
Custom rate limits, stricter than the defaults
packages.note: Free runs Zitadel's secure defaults. Turning protection on, incident response (signing out everywhere, revoking sessions, rotating keys) and setup stay free on every plan, and capacity is the plan's rate limit, not a setting. Self-hosted servers keep every setting.

packages.label: Compliance
packages.note: Quoted before activation by retained-event volume and SIEM destinations, never by user count. On Pro it can add 90-day retention; Enterprise already keeps 90 days.
